violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED CARROTS AT 125F, CHICKEN NUGGETS AT 126F, AND MASHED SWEET POTATOES AT 124 IN THE 1-DOOR HOTBOX.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION AND ADJUSTED HOTBOX. PLEASE ENSURE HOT FOODS ARE KEPT AT 135F OR ABOVE AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINKS THROUGHOUT THE FACILITY MEET TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 52-100F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. MAINTENANCE IS AWARE OF THE ISSUE AND HAD ORDERED PARTS TO FIX WATER HEATER. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS CAN MEET 100F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET 99F AT A MAXIMUM.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. MAINTENANCE IS AWARE OF THE ISSUE AND HAD ORDERED PARTS TO FIX WATER HEATER. PLEASE ENSURE 3-VAT SINK CAN MEET 110F BY THE TIME OF THE FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION.
